Records exactly which npm tarballs this library is built from (the registry's integrity hash and git head), the native fonts @qeetrix/tokens ships (each TTF's sha256 and the web WOFF2 it was made from, per its fonts/native.json) and the sha256 of every file taken from them; Scripts/verify-tokens fails if any of those files changes without a sync.
